decisions: Controller rice is a Python stdlib package with a public command interface; source templates/configuration are managed by chezmoi.
Approved profiles are SHA256-associated immutable revisions in ~/.config/rice/profiles. Drafts, reports, snapshots and active/previous setup are private runtime state.
Noctalia v5 supplies generation/rendering; approved colors are mapped to the native shell palette and application templates. Generation is sandboxed away from live Noctalia configuration.

Files, font preferences, required wallpaper/config IPC and state publication form one reversible transaction. Initial/repeated previews preserve original files, symlinks, missing files and preferences. Newly introduced adapters extend the original snapshot.
Unknown images enter draft review in the custom native thumbnail picker. The stock picker hook reverts unknown choices after an unavoidable brief wallpaper change.
Full-resolution image extrema bound transparent surfaces. Explicit adapter text-pair coverage plus semantic hue checks gate approval and application. No claim of whole-desktop WCAG conformance.

Noctalia floating panels select glass/soft/solid based on actual native preset alpha and measured contrast; Mitsuha chooses soft. Mild compositor whole-window opacity is an explicitly unverified content-contrast fallback for opaque apps.

Central interface/monospace settings persist independently from palettes. Graphical rice fonts --pick plus explicit CLI choices; target GTK, Qt6, terminal apps, shell, all4 T3 font fields, Vesktop and the Helium font bridge.
